description: Lightweight clipboard manager for Windows with AI-powered text transforms
notes: Installed from the MSI payload, so this is a genuine portable install under the Scoop
apps directory - the vendor's NSIS setup is never executed and nothing lands in
Beetroot keeps its database and settings in %APPDATA%\Beetroot (outside Scoop's
control): they survive updates, and `scoop uninstall` leaves them behind on purpose.
Remove that folder by hand if you want a clean slate.
pre_uninstall: # A running clipboard manager holds beetroot.exe open; without this both
# `scoop update` and `scoop uninstall` fail with a file-in-use error.
# Beetroot registers itself for autostart at runtime - drop the entry so an
# uninstalled app does not leave a dangling Run value behind.
